catalysts.headline: Announced expanded 7-year, $11.6B cloud services deal with Anthropic (option to scale to ~$20B total) to support Anthropic's CPU compute workloads on Akamai Cloud; issued Anthropic a warrant for up to ~5% of Akamai shares at a $111.33/share strike; also disclosed a ~$1.7B hardware supply arrangement with Lenovo and contract manufacturer Jabil for memory components.
